thread:
Evan H.: FYI deploybot failed the final promote for build 2026.03.21-rc3 to eu-ecr. It rejected the push due to an attestation digest mismatch :thinking_face:
Jess P.: Ugh, saw that alert. Is it the manifestlist platform order or the cosign timestamp drift?
Evan H.: Error from the push: `provenance: signed manifest digest abc123 != computed digest def456`
Evan H.: deploybot posted: <deploybot> publish halted for repo `redwood/runtime` tag `rc3` - provenance mismatch
Laura K.: Can someone paste the `skopeo inspect` output for both regions? I want to see if the digest drifted on mirror.
Mike C.: Quick check: `aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/runtime --image-ids imageTag=rc3 --accepted-media-types application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json` returned the expected digest in us-east-1 but eu-west-1 shows older digest.
Jess P.: So it's a replication lag vs a retag collision? If replication lag, we can wait 10m and retry. If collision, we need pin/rollback plan.
Evan H.: I compared manifest headers. The difference is in an ephemeral label injected by our CI: `buildmeta.sha` differs. The actual filesystem layers match (same layer digests) — it's the manifest annotation causing the signed digest mismatch.
Laura K.: Ok that explains cosign failing signature verification (it signs the manifest bytes including annotations). We should avoid re-signing with different annotations. For now options:
- revert tag `rc3` to previous signed manifest (pin to digest) and re-run promotion
- allow deploybot to bypass provenance for this one (not ideal)
- re-sign the eu copy to match us copy (requires KMS and audit)
Mike C.: I vote pin to digest and promote digest across regions. Minimal blast radius.
Jess P.: Agreed. Also need to add a short release note: "rc3 promotion paused due to manifest annotation mismatch; pinned to digest X and will coordinate re-signing."
Evan H.: I'll run the pin. Steps I'm doing:
```
# fetch canonical digest from us-east-1
digest=$(aws ecr batch-get-image --repo redwood/runtime --image-ids imageTag=rc3 --query 'images[0].imageManifest' --output text | sha256sum)
# promote digest to eu by create-repository if needed and put-image with imageManifest
aws ecr put-image --repository-name redwood/runtime --image-tag rc3 --image-manifest file://manifest.json
```
I'll attach logs in a follow-up. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploybot: action=hold -> reason="provenance-mismatch"; canary=staging-rc3; affected=1 cluster
Sre-bot: Reminder: any manual put-image will create a new manifest and requires cosign re-sign unless we import original manifest bytes. Audit will flag manual sign actions.
Laura K.: Good catch, thanks Evan. After pinning, let's schedule a short change window at 10:15 UTC to re-run the regional mirror job and re-sign via the automated KMS flow.
Mike C.: I'll draft the release note and send a one-line to #general once it's pinned. Also adding a TODO for CI: stop injecting ephemeral `buildmeta.sha` into the manifest when promoting between registries.
Jess P.: Follow-up: if eu region still rejects put-image, we'll escalate to registry support and consider rollback of the staging canary. But pin first.
Evan H.: Pin complete, eu now shows digest `sha256:0f1e2d3c...`. deploybot cleared the hold and resumed canary promotion :shipit:
Laura K.: Nice. Leaving the change window for re-sign at 10:15 UTC. I'll own the postmortem blurb.
Mike C.: Posting release note in-progress: "Promotion of rc3 delayed; pinned to digest sha256:0f1e2d3c due to manifest annotation variance across mirrors. Resigned artifacts will be published during maintenance window."
Jess P.: Closing actions: (1) remove ephemeral manifest annotations from promotion path (ticket created), (2) add a regression test for manifest parity across mirrors, (3) update deploybot to detect annotation-only diffs and suggest import instead of re-sign.
Evan H.: Thanks all. Logging this thread into the release ticket. :white_check_mark:
